annotation.interpretation_a: The clause does not specify whether the initiating endpoint must ensure that the peer’s own pool of connection IDs is large enough, or that the pool of connection IDs it can provide to the peer is large enough. This ambiguity could lead to different implementation behaviours.
annotation.justification: The clause’s wording leaves the intended pool unspecified, creating an incomplete constraint that affects implementation.
annotation.missing_information: Clarification of which pool (peer’s own or the pool the initiator can provide) is intended would resolve the ambiguity.
